text_block_list.text:
While discussing strategy for the next 
mock race—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat!? Maya doesn't want that! I wanna 
go way more whooosh~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer-chan, don't you want to see Maya 
pull off a brilliant runaway win!?"
choice_data_list:
Still, maybe you should have come from 
behind this time...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
No waaaay! If you're gonna go that far, 
you better get Maya in the mood!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
If you keep Maya entertained, I'll listen 
to what Trainer-chan says!
This is quite a difficult problem...

Since she can be a bit moody, it might be 
best to put myself out there on the line 
to entertain her right now.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Sure thing♪ What are we competing in?
choice_data_list:
Whoever looks away first in the staring 
contest loses!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Something that simple is fine? Alright 
then, ready, set—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Eep!?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer-chan... Looking at Maya with 
such passionate eyes...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Noooo! I can't take this anymooore~~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait, Trainer-chan! One more time! 
Maya's gonna win this time!

Even after that, Mayano Top Gun kept 
losing, but for some reason, she looked 
remarkably happy—

In the end, she promised to run the mock 
race according to my suggestion.

However, she might be starting to get 
bored of meetings by now.
choice_data_list: Shall we head out for a breather, then?

text_block_list.text:
I decided to take Mayano Top Gun out for a 
walk around the academy grounds.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~♪ Going for a stroll with my 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Walking together like this almost makes it 
feel like a date on campus, doesn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Just kiddingâª
choice_data_list: I'm just glad you enjoyed yourself.
I'm just glad you enjoyed yourself.

text_block_list.text:
Now in a great mood, Mayano Top Gun 
promised to run according to my suggestion 
in the practice race.

However, if I can entertain her while also 
helping her understand the importance of 
strategy—
choice_data_list:
How about we watch some videos for a 
change of pace?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Agreed, totally agreed!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what it is, maybe a romance 
movie~? Maya can't wait~♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ......Trainer-chan, what might this be?
choice_data_list:
It's "Secrets of Race Tactics: Basics 
Edition", but...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'm asking you why I have to study just to 
relax!
choice_data_list:
I thought going over the basics again 
would convince them.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer-chan, you big dummy! You 
insensitive blockhead!!"

Having pouted completely, Mayano Top Gun 
stormed off in anger.
